property.name: Mode
property.summary: Selects committed download, staged follow, or stream follow behavior.

property.name: SourceSessionID
property.summary: Required source session identifier for staged-follow and stream-follow download modes.

property.name: CompletionMode
property.summary: Controls how one-call follow operations decide when to stop.

property.name: MaxBytes
property.summary: Optional byte limit applied when the completion mode uses a bounded length.

property.name: BindLiveStreamItem
property.summary: Whether the opened or resumed stream-follow session should bind a live DataStreamItem to the buffered follow stream.
